description: Baseline: confirm the repo is green before changes and learn how the render harness works.
steps: Run every tools/*.test.mjs and record that all pass
Read /projects/sandbox/_h/g.mjs and one h*.mjs that renders a view, to learn how to call run(state, now) and obtain HTML of the Gym tab
Record in findings: harness usage, the gym render function name, and the click-dispatch location
verification: for f in tools/*.test.mjs; do node $f || exit 1; done
findings: Baseline green: chk.sh prints 'syntax ok'; all 35 tools/*.test.mjs exit 0. Harness: _h/g.mjs exports run(state,now) which evals the largest inline script of index.html with a stub DOM and returns an object of exposed names from a hard-coded return list (finance only). A new harness must copy g.mjs/h9.mjs and change that return list to include gym functions (e.g. gviewImpl, gMuscleSets, muscleOf, S:()=>S, eval:x=>eval(x)). h9.mjs has a fuller stub with per-id elements (els map) so #gout innerHTML can be read after calling gview(). Sample state: /projects/sandbox/forma-backup-3dias.json. Gym render: gview() (index.html ~3805) wraps gviewImpl() (~3808), which writes `$('#gout').innerHTML=` at ~3832 (Gym stats card, h3 with 'Gym stats'); insert new cards near there. Click dispatcher: document click handler with `else if(a=='gdlon')` chain at ~4875 (data-a actions). Only .kiro/ is untracked; nothing committed.
